sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [OWNERSHIP_PATH] gen:IMO043_AssociatedEquipmentShape/gen:IMO043_HazardCoverageShape: The associated-equipment branch applies hasApplicableHazard and hasHazardProtectionEvidence directly to associatedEquipmentItem nodes, but both canonical properties have machineryInstallationItem as their required owner/domain. This makes the associated-equipment coverage checks use predicates outside their authoritative ownership scope and can change which RDF assertions satisfy the requirement. Required change: Model associated-equipment hazard applicability and protection evidence through paths owned by the associated equipment, or use an authoritative canonical relationship/path that evaluates the owning machinery installation without applying machinery-owned properties directly to associatedEquipmentItem nodes.
